prompts.walk: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite animation atlas for the existing portfolio studio. Input image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY: preserve the same man, curly short hair, rectangular glasses, subtle goatee, navy blue jacket, white geometric t-shirt, light blue jeans, blue-and-white sneakers, red wristband, silver laptop carried steadily by his LEFT arm. Same polished stylized 3D render, proportions, anatomy, clothing and face across every frame. Orthographic full body view, fixed camera and lighting. Every single figure complete from top of hair to the entire soles and both shoes, consistent scale and ground baseline, ample transparent margins, no frame overlap, NO text, NO numbers, NO grid lines, NO ground plane, NO shadows, NO extra objects. Genuine transparent background, clean alpha without colored fringe. Read frames left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Exactly 16 distinct evenly spaced sequential frames, arranged in an EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows regular grid, square atlas. A complete seamless WALK cycle moving towards screen RIGHT in a consistent right-facing three-quarter side profile. Gentle natural stride, alternating full left/right steps through contact, down, passing, up positions. Torso and head remain stable; laptop stable in left arm; free right arm swings subtly. Continuous motion with small differences between adjacent frames, including the last back to first. All characters fit entirely inside their cells, especially the rear foot.

prompts.wave: Generate a TRANSPARENT PNG CUTOUT SPRITE SHEET. PORTRAIT canvas with EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and SIX ROWS = 24 evenly spaced frames. IMPORTANT: the WHOLE CANVAS is transparent alpha zero outside the 24 human cutouts. NO visible background at all, NO colored gradient, NO lighting halo, NO shadow, NO checkerboard painted into image. Reference image 1 is identity reference: this exact stylized 3D man with curly short hair, rectangular glasses and goatee, blue jacket, white geometric shirt, light jeans, blue-white sneakers, red wristband, holding laptop in LEFT arm. Reference image 2 demonstrates the EXISTING clean separated cutout sprite atlas, preserve that rendering and identity, but output 24 frames in FOUR columns SIX rows portrait canvas. Orthographic front three-quarter view, identical proportions and height ALL frames. Frame cell has transparent padding 15 percent on ALL sides. Each entire full-body character is small enough to fit cell with EVERY shoe sole, head and hands completely visible. NEVER stretch or squeeze lower rows. 24 frames run row-major chronological order. Fixed body scale, planted feet at identical coordinates in every cell, very subtle body movement. Right arm is the free moving arm, left arm holds laptop steadily. No text, borders, grid or labels. One complete friendly wave: frames 1-4 neutral to raising right arm; frames 5-18 open hand gently waving side to side with small continuous differences; frames 19-24 right arm gradually lowers back to identical original neutral. Both feet stay planted.
